timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I lost my job and I’m still absorbing it.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind keeps replaying how it happened.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I feel afraid about what comes next.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I’m comparing myself to who I was before this.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels shaken by how sudden this was.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want to fix this immediately.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels like this says something about my worth.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel lost right now.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This is a lot to carry all at once.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let myself feel this before I act.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: This says something about the situation, not my value.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to have a plan today.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I’m more than the job I just lost.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften even in this uncertainty.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can take this one day at a time.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to grieve this before I move forward.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can ask for support instead of handling this alone.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can give myself room to land.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust that I’ll find my footing again.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My skills and worth are still mine.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can face what’s next when I’m ready.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can see this as a chapter, not the whole story.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can begin to settle.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m capable of building what comes next.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: This doesn’t define me.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can move forward at my own pace.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to take one step when I’m ready.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
